Very good value restaurant
Dec 2018 • Couples
Really good restaurant. We found that place by chance during our stay in Mui Ne. We first founf the small shop with a bit of everything at low price too (very cheap local wine, sunscreen, mosquito repellent, headphones...) Then we went for the restaurant because prices were very attractive. We didn't regret our choice. Food was very good and prices pretty low. Everything was much cheaper than in our place (long son backpacker). 
In addition, the ownercan speak good English and other employees speak also a bit of English. They all are really warm and smiling.
We are going back there this evening :)

Written February 6, 2018
Trinh N
Dear valued customer, we thank you for raising your concern. In regards to this incident, we sincerely apologise that you felt subject to verbal aggression in our establishment, we strongly condemn any such behaviours. The Vietnamese people and their use of language is often misinterpreted as sounding aggressive. Cultured people in rural areas such as this speak with great expression, emotion and use of tone, this case is no exception. Our member of staff was was extremely buy on this occasion and under pressure due to a high volume of customers. After answering your query our staff member then announced her exit from your table as to allow you more time to come to a decision. On her return she explained due to our high volumes that there may be a 20 to 25 minute waiting period before you would have received your dishes. To a western ear our staffs tone may have sounded aggressive but to our member of staff this was her natural use of language meaning no offence what so ever. Bare in mind that English is not our staff members first language so this would factor the short and broken phrases which you may have relied on this occasion. We would like to thank you for bringing this matter to our attention. Our staff will be advised and further trained as to ensure that this sort of incident will not reoccur..
We sincerely apologise and hope of your return in the future, for you to receive a truly authentic and cultural experience here at Trinh Restaurant.
